images.title: Two 8, 8, 6 triangles make a rhombus
images.purpose: Shows two copies of the triangle with sides 8 cm, 8 cm and 6 cm joined along the 6 cm side, giving four outer sides of 8 cm: a rhombus.
images.composition: Plain white background, the main object large and centred with wide empty margins, no scenery, no characters, no extra decoration. One large rhombus in the centre made of two lightly shaded triangles that share the 6 cm side.
images.exact_structure: One rhombus standing on a sharp corner, about 2.5 times as tall as it is wide, in dark outline. The short horizontal shared side across its middle is a dashed dark line labelled 6 cm. The top triangle is lightly filled teal (#0072B2) and the bottom triangle, an identical copy, is lightly filled amber (#E69F00). Each of the four outer sides carries one identical short tick mark and is labelled 8 cm. No angle marks and no corner letters. Nothing else in the frame.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
images.takeaway: Joining two 8, 8, 6 triangles along the 6 cm side gives four equal sides, a rhombus.
images.description: Shows two copies of the triangle with sides 8 cm, 8 cm and 6 cm joined along the 6 cm side, giving four outer sides of 8 cm: a rhombus.
images.context: Joined along the 6 cm side every outer side is 8 cm; the other joins appear in the next concept's image.

image_decisions.why: One clear join, the outer sides all 8 cm, shows how two triangles become a quadrilateral.
